name: NostalgiKSU Gaming Profile v1

runtime_policy.cpu_maximum: highest frequency advertised by each device CPU policy
runtime_policy.gpu_maximum: highest frequency advertised by the device GPU driver
runtime_policy.frequency_mode: stock maximum only; no fabricated frequency or voltage entries
runtime_policy.thermal_mode: retain vendor thermal mitigation and critical shutdown

prohibited: hard-coded universal CPU or GPU frequencies
new or modified OPP or voltage tables without device source and validation
thermal-zone deletion or thermal shutdown bypass
stable catalog publication before pilot and soak tests pass
promotion_gates: boot, Wi-Fi, cellular, camera, audio, charging and suspend smoke tests pass
sustained gaming thermal soak completes without shutdown or uncontrolled throttling
frame-time and input-latency results beat or match the stable baseline
